figures.label: Proposition 3
figures.content: Entire original shaded Proposition 3 box, including the chain rule and data-processing inequality (138)
reading_notes: The joint KL equals the x-marginal KL plus the expected conditional posterior KL.
The proof is transcribed and expanded in the article; this crop preserves the original proposition only.

figures.label: Remark 42
figures.content: Entire original Remark 42 box concerning joint matching and the aggregate latent marginal
reading_notes: Original wording is preserved; matching joint distributions alone does not guarantee low paired reconstruction distortion.
The article provides a counterexample and distinguishes distributional matching from reconstruction quality.

figures.label: Remark 43
figures.content: Entire original Remark 43 box, including the posterior identity and the source's equals-zero typo
reading_notes: The source's equality of two joint distributions to zero is a typographical error and is not silently edited in this crop.
Even an exact posterior alone does not guarantee matching the model marginal to the data distribution.
The article separately explains these errors and the meaning of variational inference.

figures.label: Figure 22
figures.content: Both complete panels, all latent visualizations and rates/distortions, and the entire Figure 22 caption
reading_notes: The left panel illustrates that improved reconstruction FID can accompany worse generation FID across tokenizer configurations.
The right panel distinguishes perceptual compression from semantic compression on a rate-distortion diagram.
The caption labels both panels Right; the article explains this source label typo and interprets panels by their actual positions.
This is an empirical illustration, not a theorem that reconstruction and generation must always trade off.
